findings.detail: A persistent outage receives a later sampling timestamp on the very next feed read, so its stable issue key remains the same but its acknowledgement watermark is already stale. The UI promises an acknowledged view and a recurrence-only return, yet an owner who clears an understood outage is forced back into the same alert loop without any recovery transition. This is a landed-with-gap correctness failure in the primary issue-management action, not an optimistic-UI concern.

This is a context-discarding final hop and an error-to-calm deception, distinct from the ledger's already-completed generic last-hop repair.

audits.ideal: Issues is a condition ledger, not a repeatedly sampled alarm: each condition has a stable onset, acknowledgement watermark, recovery, and genuinely new recurrence. Audit is the immutable event ledger, and every failure row opens an exact, scoped issue group or explicitly says why that group is unavailable; its resulting empty state names the inherited evidence scope rather than asserting fleet calm. Both remain terse Dispatch surfaces, keyboard-first, with one unbroken row-to-condition-to-occurrence-to-session trace and clear recovery when any hop is unavailable.
audits.jarvis_gap: The two surfaces now expose real grouped failures, typed audit outcomes, keyboard row traversal, loading/error states, and several trace doors, so they are no longer a decorative log. They still break the five-second trust loop in two consequential places: an acknowledgement of a continuously-down butler is treated as a new recurrence on the next poll, and an audit failure's advertised Issues door deliberately narrows evidence to the default seven-day client-side substring view, where a miss can be presented as a global all-clear. The owner cannot safely distinguish an acknowledged persistent condition from a new failure, nor rely on the promised final evidence hop.

audits.ideal: A condition is an evidence scope, not a flat row. From one condition row, the owner can open a URL-backed dossier of its linked symptoms and research, see truthful unavailable and empty states independently, and return without losing the chosen condition. Linked records name and link their condition, while unlinked records remain honestly unscoped. This makes a health concern a short, keyboard-reachable signal-to-record-to-source trail without inventing a diagnosis or clinical conclusion.
audits.jarvis_gap: Health is a calm, well-instrumented ledger with honest primary loading and failure states, but it still loses a clinical investigation's scope at the condition boundary. A condition can be the meaningful root context for symptoms and research, yet an owner can only edit or delete that condition and must manually rediscover related evidence. That breaks the single-pane detect-to-diagnose path even though the underlying fact contracts retain the relationship.

That leaves the detect-to-diagnose-to-act loop short of the five-second, earned-calm standard.

findings.detail: This is not the already-known Card migration or the already-owned raw status-color sweep. It is a contract-level semantic collision: the design-language source of truth says the identity ramp is exclusive, but other canonical specs and shared helpers require exceptions that are not represented in that source of truth. The implementation therefore cannot satisfy all binding specs at once, and local eslint suppressions can turn blue into identity, category, or health without a fleet-wide arbiter. Five-second scanning depends on color having stable meaning across surfaces; a token namespace whose meaning changes by caller weakens that trust even when every individual color has acceptable contrast and both themes render correctly. No active PR or current OpenSpec change covers this reconciliation, and the blocked bu-27dxl.12 owns Card/full-palette/status mechanics rather than the contradictory identity-versus-categorical contracts.

audits.ideal: Every visual color request names its semantic role rather than a palette slot: butler identity, operational state, local category, chart series, severity, or owner-selected custom color. A typed registry owns each role, ButlerMark alone can resolve butler identity hues, non-butler taxonomies resolve through the dedicated categorical ramp, and state resolves only through StateDot tone semantics. Canonical OpenSpec documents are generated from or checked against the same registry, while a repo-wide lint rule rejects cross-role token use, so dark and light surfaces cannot silently create a second meaning for an existing hue.
audits.jarvis_gap: Dispatch now has a serious normative token system, theme-aware ramps, shared primitives, and several enforcement ratchets, so the product is substantially closer to one hand than earlier audits found. The remaining new gap is below the component layer: the binding visual-language spec and index.css reserve --category-* for ButlerMark identity and provide --categorical-* for every other local taxonomy, while canonical domain specs, exported helpers, tests, and consumers still deliberately reuse --category-* for entity types, contact labels, chart series, and staffer health. As a result one blue can mean Chronicler identity, a person entity, a hashed family label, or healthy staffer state, and the existing lint can certify each local choice without ever proving the fleet-wide one-hue-one-meaning contract.

The result is a system that usually feels fast and live, but can silently fall back to five-minute freshness and still makes common keyboard/detail transitions pay avoidable cold work.

audits.ideal: Accessibility is a route- and state-complete product contract, not a set of local tests. Every registered route, including parameterized dossiers, declares representative loading, loaded, degraded, empty, and consequential-overlay scenarios in one manifest; those scenarios run axe and keyboard interaction checks against production components. Rendered text colors are checked after alpha compositing in both themes, and every tabbable control inherits one canonical focus-visible treatment unless an explicitly tested replacement is declared. New routes, semantic text variants, menus, or outline suppression cannot merge without extending that same contract.
audits.jarvis_gap: The dashboard has a credible accessibility foundation: repo-wide jsx-a11y linting, semantic shared primitives, an empty axe skip manifest, token contrast tests, a global focus-visible rule, and reduced-motion handling, but its guarantees stop at the edges that matter most in daily operation. The generalized route gate certifies loading shells rather than populated workflows, opacity-modified text escapes the otherwise strong contrast contract, and native form controls can fall outside the global focus floor. The result is solid but not yet the keyboard-first, one-hand-built JARVIS surface promised by Dispatch: conformance can be green while a real operator state is unreadable or loses its visible keyboard locus.

audits.ideal: Every dispatch carries a typed inference intent derived deterministically from the trigger and session contract: required capabilities, context envelope, latency/deadline, consequence class, and budget. The resolver first filters for hard fit, then chooses within an owner-governed policy using cohort-specific owner-visible outcomes and measured cost, with bounded low-risk exploration so evidence can improve without gambling consequential work. A session may request one pre-side-effect capability escalation when the initial tier is genuinely insufficient. Every choice writes a compact, prompt-free resolution receipt that lets the owner answer in five seconds: what was requested, which candidates were eligible, why this one won, whether policy or quota changed it, what it cost, and whether the result later proved useful.
audits.jarvis_gap: The landed inference-efficiency pack made routing faster and evidence-aware, but the evidence still describes whether a runtime completed, not whether the chosen model was fit for this task or useful to the owner. Resolution sees a butler name and one guessed complexity tier before the full prompt/context is composed; it does not see required tool/structured-output/resume capabilities, context size, deadline, or consequence level. Its score pools every workload for a catalog entry, uses a synthetic fixed-token price, treats an undelivered interaction as a successful model attempt, and greedily exploits a winner only inside the operator's top-priority tie. The owner can see the final model label and an attempt trail, but not the candidate set or why policy chose it.

audits.ideal: The ideal is one Relationship-owned, evidence-bearing, coverage-aware, bitemporal structural graph: every accepted literal or entity edge retains immutable typed evidence receipts and a source-session door; every predicate query returns present, absent_proven, unknown, or unavailable with the coverage assertion that earned that state; and standing relationships carry explicit effective intervals independent of assertion time, observation time, confidence, and staleness. Relationship MCP reads and owner APIs return these truth packets without model work, while narrative or episodic edges remain in each butler's memory facts exactly as the active single-home change requires. An owner asking what was true, why it is believed, or whether nothing is known receives a deterministic answer with an inspectable evidence path, never a plausible inference from silence.
audits.jarvis_gap: Today Butlers has a registry-validated canonical relationship graph, a separate narrative-memory graph, a central structural writer, staleness bands, and owner-facing fact and neighbour reads. The remaining JARVIS gap is epistemic rather than volumetric: typed evidence passed to the structural writer survives only while a claim is parked for approval, an empty result says nothing about whether the domain was actually observed, and observed_at says when the system saw a claim rather than when the relationship held in the world. The system can therefore repeat a current-looking claim, but it cannot reliably prove why it believes it, distinguish ignorance from verified absence, or reconstruct what was true at a past moment.

ranked_moves.slice_plan: Derive one healthy|late|down state from ready-state plus a clock-driven heartbeat deadline; reconnect a late stream; drive polling, LiveIndicator, and announcements from that single value; add fake-clock tests for before-first-message, timely heartbeat, missed heartbeat, recovery, and timer cleanup.
ranked_moves.overlap: No open issue matched this half-open freshness contract.

ranked_moves.title: Make every verdict and recovery action declare one evidence cohort
ranked_moves.why: Across Dashboard, Butlers, Calendar, Education, Chronicles, System, Decisions, governance readers, QA/session dossiers, and notification recovery, the visible verdict, source readiness, and Retry or Refresh action are assembled independently. Loading can look empty, partial coverage can look healthy, filtered scope can inherit global counts, and a named refresh can leave the warning's sources untouched.
ranked_moves.evidence: DashboardPage supplies unsettled derived empties; ButlersPage excludes partial degradation from NeedsYouStrip; CalendarVerdictOpener receives connectedSources rather than request scope; Chronicles and System refresh different subsets from their verdicts; Decision Desk has no readable-snapshot reconciliation; Settings and QA detail failures have terminal error leaves.
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Specify a typed evidence-cohort contract: named sources, settled/loading/empty/partial/failed state, as-of, scope, retained-data posture, and one cohort refresh. 2) Prove it on Dashboard, Butlers, and Calendar openers. 3) Make Chronicles and System refresh atomic against their declared cohorts. 4) Reuse the contract for Decision Desk, permissions/catalog, Education review/analytics, and QA/session detail recovery. 5) Require mutation recovery actions such as notification Retry/Escalate to acknowledge their actual result. 6) Add a structural test that a verdict cannot assert calm until its cohort settles.
ranked_moves.overlap: bu-a459g and bu-qwesi own broad query-coercion cleanup/enforcement. Reuse and extend them for leaf consumers; this move owns the higher-level source-cohort and refresh invariant rather than refiling frozen sites.

ranked_moves.title: Make proactive calm provable with source-run and evidence-freshness receipts
ranked_moves.why: The broker can show queued, delivered, and failed candidates but cannot prove that every expected Health, Finance, Relationship, or Travel detector ran before silence. Candidate expiry is not evidence freshness, so a syntactically live insight can be derived from stale or partially unavailable inputs.
ranked_moves.evidence: scheduled_jobs.py registers independent insight jobs; insights_v1 and /api/system/insights/delivery-state aggregate candidates only. InsightCandidate and propose_candidate carry expiry plus optional metadata but no producer run, typed evidence, observed-at, or fresh-until contract.
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Add a manifesto-owned source registry and append-only scan-run receipts, including healthy zero-candidate runs, watermark, partial/failed/missed states, and lateness policy. 2) Make producer_run_id, typed evidence refs, evidence_observed_at, and evidence_fresh_until mandatory for new candidates. 3) Revalidate freshness immediately before delivery and mark stale evidence rather than notify. 4) Add a System coverage ledger and condition lifecycle for missed sources. 5) Pilot Finance and Travel, then Health and Relationship, without changing their detection logic.
ranked_moves.overlap: Shadow certification and useful-action-window ranking are sequenced after this substrate and are listed as deferred, not separate execution children.

ranked_moves.title: Make DispatchIntent, model capabilities, and resolution receipts the inference contract
ranked_moves.why: Routing now uses historical evidence, but that evidence is pooled runtime completion rather than task usefulness, and model eligibility does not prove tool, structured-output, resume, context, deadline, or consequence fit. A successful first attempt also leaves no durable explanation of the candidate set or why the selected model won.

ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Amend Switchboard's infrastructure contract for fleet inference policy without adding domain logic. 2) Define deterministic DispatchIntent and adapter capability descriptors. 3) Add validated model-catalog capabilities/context limits and fail closed for required unknown features. 4) Filter hard fit before ranking. 5) Persist a prompt-free resolution receipt with intent, candidates, exclusions, evidence age, overrides, and winner reason, then expose it as a session dossier door. 6) Add mixed-adapter, quota, failover, and degraded-receipt tests.
ranked_moves.overlap: Preserve landed run-07 inference efficiency. Cohort-quality exploration and guarded capability escalation are deferred until hard-fit and receipt evidence exist.

ranked_moves.title: Version domain-event contracts and close every wake with a reaction receipt
ranked_moves.why: Domain events enforce only a syntactic name and arbitrary JSON. The live ledger contains two Travel-to-Finance failed_permanent deliveries despite the current receiver/configuration appearing present.

ranked_moves.title: Make the canonical relationship graph evidence-bearing, coverage-aware, and bitemporal
ranked_moves.why: The structural fact writer validates typed evidence but discards it when a fact becomes active. Empty reads cannot distinguish unknown from observed-empty, and observed_at records when a claim was seen rather than when a real relationship held. The graph can repeat a fact but cannot deterministically answer why, whether absence was proved, or what was true at a past time.
ranked_moves.evidence: relationship_assert_fact.py forwards evidence only to the approval path; active entity_facts have no evidence ledger. Facts/neighbours return empty containers with no predicate coverage state. entity_facts has assertion/observation timestamps but no effective interval.
ranked_moves.slice_plan: 1) Specify a structural truth packet with immutable typed evidence, target-unavailable semantics, and source-session door. 2) Persist evidence atomically for direct and approved writes. 3) Add predicate/source coverage receipts composing to present|absent_proven|unknown|unavailable. 4) Add effective_from/effective_to plus precision and safe cardinality/overlap rules. 5) Expose evidence, coverage, and as-of reads through Relationship MCP and owner APIs without embedding raw source content.

ranked_moves.title: Make accessibility guarantees route- and state-complete
ranked_moves.why: The accessibility baseline is strong, but the route gate runs axe on loading shells, omits dynamic dossiers, and disables contrast checks. Separately, opacity-modified semantic text falls below 4.5:1 in both themes and native controls can escape the global focus-visible floor.

ranked_moves.overlap: Extends, rather than reopens, landed run-07 population gates. No current open issue owns the route-state completeness or composed-contrast contract.
